node: Optical interconnect, lasers, silicon photonics, and compound-semiconductor epitaxy tools
summary: Layer 1B expansion finds the strongest US-listed mapping not only in obvious optical-component vendors, but in silicon-photonics foundry capacity and wafer-level reliability test equipment. The underfollowed lane is more interesting where the company sits one or two steps away from the optical-module headline: Tower as a silicon-photonics foundry partner, Aehr as wafer-level burn-in/test for silicon photonics and AI optical I/O, and MACOM as a supplier of 1.6T/3.2T optical-connectivity components including CW lasers and drivers. Lumentum is included only as a reference anchor for laser and cloud-transceiver demand. Claims below are research candidates, not buy/sell recommendations.
